name: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Ltd
title: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Ltd - 543965 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Asset-light 3PL with Q4 revenue Rs 3,032 cr (+21.3% YoY) and adjusted EBITDA margin 7.3%; GFS margins stay thin at 2.4% and management guides FY27 margin flat at 7.3-7.4%.

capex.quote: we don't invest in any fixed assets

triggers.label: GFS freight rates under pressure
triggers.quote: global freight rates continue to remain under pressure

triggers.label: ISCS margin target 9.5-10%
triggers.quote: we'll be somewhere between 9.5% to 10% on ISCS

triggers.label: Q4 new business wins Rs 523.7 cr record
triggers.quote: new business wins, which is an all-time high in a quarter of Rs. 523.7 crores

guidance.quote: we remain very confident of a double -digit maybe an early teen kind of number for the whole year
we'll be somewhere between 9.5% to 10% on ISCS
we are at should be around 7.3% to 7.4% on the adjusted EBITDA
move it to closer to 5% and hopefully settle at about 6%, 6.5%

prior_guidance_check.quote: we have delivered on our commitment that we made in the previous quarter on our quarter 4 growth

red_flags.label: GFS margin 2.4%, freight pricing volatile
red_flags.quote: global freight rates continue to remain under pressure

red_flags.label: Net debt Rs 350-370 cr; ECL charge Rs 56 cr FY26
red_flags.quote: we have total booked about Rs. 56 crores for fiscal FY26

evasions.quote: it will be speculation if I get deeper on that
I will leave that question to Vikas for the future
